scores.rationale: The version-three contract pins the baseline branch, commit, record, donor A-N inventory, and accepted/rejected decisions. The baseline is an ancestor of the candidate, the bounded history contains no merge commits, and both supplied fingerprints reproduced exactly from the candidate tree.

The lifecycle check passed with 76 intake records, 307 sources, 103 claims, 68 inquiries, 54 held mature claims, 18 canonically linked proofs, and four explicit proof-debt items. All 52 lifecycle mutation tests and all 10 citation tests passed, covering graph references, dispositions, unsupported projections, corrections, and public-source boundaries.

Agency relations classify the proof bank as an exact set and retain bounded action, support, confidence, credit scope, and anti-claims. Composite mutations detected sole causality, title inflation, endorsement drift, and collaborator erasure. The KC Spaces Fund role eval independently passed 100/100, including bounded role and collective-credit criteria.

Intake, query, and report help text clearly describes bounded operation. Intake is exclusive-create or validation-only and cannot promote claims; query is read-only, public-safe, and capped; report supports read-only stdout review. Composite tests passed safe-input, invalid-input, broken-graph, non-promotion, and compiled-leak mutations.

The survivorship register covers the exact reviewed population and all four statuses, keeps non-recovery explicitly distinct from nonexistence, separates six rights and consent dimensions, and blocks automatic promotion on research re-entry. Mutation tests detected absence overclaim, status drift, missing rights dimensions, and automatic promotion.

The composition manifest covers every public route or route template with audience, argument, action, budget, selections, and omission rationale. Exact-set and render-binding tests passed, budgets include proofs and direct projections, unselected knowledge remains explicitly held, and the fingerprint-bound mosaic review preserves six combination-risk holds.

I independently reproduced the frozen contract and exact-candidate fingerprints, authored no patch, and evaluated only my own receipt-level trust. The instrument enforces exact schemas, distinct read-only judges, candidate binding, mutation-sensitive rejection, and conservative aggregation. Per version three, only the aggregate checker may derive CI-007 = 4 after validating two unseen independent receipts, so this receipt remains 3.

On Node 26, TypeScript, ESLint, the production webpack build, static generation, standalone asset assembly, route checks, citation checks, portfolio checks, and focused composite checks passed. A standalone staging runtime returned HTTP 200 for health and principal routes and enforced noindex through health state, robots.txt, and metadata. Exact-candidate human keyboard, screen-reader, mobile, PDF, and trusted-reader QA remains pending, so this receipt does not award complete layered verification.

PR-019 and PR-025 remain explicitly pending human review with null candidate binding, no reviewers, and stated blocking reasons. Rights, consent, display, and mosaic holds remain visible, production indexing is approval-gated, and mutation tests reject automated approval. No machine or AI result is represented as a human decision.
